claims.statement: The company expects to open 40 to 50 stores in the near term.
claims.quote: We are primed and ready in terms of opening around 40-50 stores. I mean anything between that is what we are ready and we will deliver broadly.

claims.statement: Management targets new store openings to reach 60 to 70 per year in another two to three years.
claims.quote: If you were to look at our store opening trend, we do 40-something stores, but in another two to three years, this 40 should go to a 60 or a 70 per year.

claims.statement: General merchandise and apparel broad trend line is expected to remain around current run rates of approximately 23%.
claims.quote: A broad trend line will be around the current run rates of around 23%, is the sense we get.

claims.statement: The company plans to continue with the current DMart Ready model without adopting quick commerce.
claims.quote: We don't intend to do any quick commerce. I think our model is pretty robust and the learnings have been to try and get more and more revenue in the large towns / cities.

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts delivered 30.3 crores bill cuts in FY24.
facts.quote: We delivered 30.3 crores bill cuts in the year just gone by.

facts.statement: Total retail business area reached 15.1 million square feet at the end of fiscal 24.
facts.quote: The total retail business area at the end of the fiscal '24 was about 15.1 million square feet.

facts.statement: Standalone revenue from operations for FY24 was INR49,533 crores.
facts.quote: Moving on, the revenue from operations as disclosed earlier is INR49,533 crores, delivered in the stand-alone business.

facts.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin for FY24 was 8.3%.
facts.quote: EBITDA margin of 8.3%, so almost INR4,100 crores of EBITDA.

facts.statement: The company opened 41 stores in the fiscal year gone by.
facts.quote: We opened 41 stores in last year gone by.

facts.statement: Avenue E-commerce delivered a 31.7% sales increase close to INR2,900 crores with a loss of INR185 crores.
facts.quote: Avenue E-commerce delivered a 31.7% sales increase, close to INR2,900 crores and we had a loss of INR185 crores, which was a 240 bps loss reduction over the prior year.

facts.statement: The company reported ROCE of 19.1% and a return on net worth of 15.1% for FY24.
facts.quote: ROCE came at about 19.1%, marginally lower than FY '23 and the return on net worth about 15.1%.
